label: Bid simulator formula mapping concept
author: Rushali
description: Maps the bid simulator formula to selected settings and targeting-level table values inside the simulation modal.
feedbackAddressed: Clarifies the relationship between the top formula and the simulator table.
Shows growth ambition as per-targeting values instead of one global percentage.
Removes cannibalization from the visible simulator because it is not editable.
Shows Timing & Placement as an influence on Ads CVR.
